name: Dolcetto d'Alba

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Dolcetto sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Dolcetto gives fresh, dry reds with some tannin.

blurb.text: A Piedmont red wine made from Dolcetto alone, from communes around Alba, Barolo and Barbaresco among them. Its zone lies almost wholly in the province of Cuneo, with one commune in Asti province.
